Tavola: X = tempo, Y = nota. Disegna per: Canvas: X = time, Y = note. Draw to compose.
Spessore = volume · opacità = brillantez: Thickness = volume · opacity = brightness · height = note
Sequenza dei pattern: tocca per cambiare: Pattern sequence: tap to switch between A, B or rest
Suona i pad con le dita o la Pencil (tas: Play the pads with your fingers or the Pencil (keys A S D F G H J K).
Tocca un pad per cambiarlo, trascina per: Tap a pad to change it, drag to paint several steps. Tap the name to hear the sound, hold it for volume and tuning. A and B are two patterns: the sequence decides which one plays in each bar (– = rest).
Disegna un ciclo del suono: il bordo sop: Draw one cycle of the sound: the top edge is the left channel, the bottom edge the right.
Un ciclo dell'onda: sopra il canale sini: One wave cycle: left channel on top, right channel below
L'onda che si sente: sinistra in blu, de: The wave you hear: left in blue, right in orange
Come la colonna sonora ottica di Norman: Like the optical soundtracks of Norman McLaren, who drew sound directly onto film. Two fingers undo, three redo.
Note lette dal disegno e dal beat: Notes read from the drawing and the beat
Un file .zip con il mix in WAV (44,1 kHz: A .zip file with the mix as WAV (44.1 kHz, 16-bit), MIDI with one track per layer, and the project.
un WAV per livello, per GarageBand: one WAV per layer, for GarageBand
In GarageBand per iPad: salva in File, p: In GarageBand for iPad: save to Files, then open the Files tab in the Loop Browser and drag the WAV or MIDI onto a track.
La tavola disegnata come PNG, oppure il: The drawn canvas as a PNG, or the project (.json) to reopen here on another device.

La scala sceglie su quali righe cadono l: The scale sets which rows notes land on in the Quantized and Legato readings; Optical ignores it and follows the line.
Sensibilità alta: serve premere di più p: High sensitivity: you need to press harder for a thick stroke (and a loud sound). Minimum thickness: how thin the stroke stays when you first touch down.
Con Solo Pencil le dita non disegnano: s: With Pencil only, fingers don't draw: they scroll, zoom and do gestures (two fingers undo, three redo, four play). Automatic turns on as soon as you use the Pencil.
Il volume di ascolto non cambia i file e: Listening volume doesn't change exported files, which are normalized. Each layer's volume and reverb are in the Layers panel.
Pennello o gomma già attivi, tocco: Tap the active brush or eraser
Grease Pencil to Music, web app. Si aggi: Grease Pencil to Music, web app. It updates itself when you open the app while online; your drawings stay on this device.
Tocca un livello per sceglierlo, di nuov: Tap a layer to select it, tap again for its settings. Hold it for Duplicate, Merge down, Clear and Delete; hold and drag to move it. Swipe left to delete it, right to select more than one. Hold the eye or the speaker to see or hear only that layer.
Tocca per registrare · massimo 8 s: Tap to record · up to 8 s
Canta una nota, batti le mani, registra: Sing a note, clap your hands, record an object: it becomes an instrument tuned to the rows. Or import an audio file (WAV, MP3, M4A, even one exported from GarageBand with Share → Save to Files).
Cambia nota a ogni riga che attraversa,: Changes note at every row it crosses, snapped to the scale and the grid.
Alla McLaren: l'altezza segue la linea i: McLaren-style: pitch follows the line continuously, with glissandos. Even piano, marimba, bell and guitar sustain and slide; percussion stays as hits.
Note della scala unite da glissandi: una: Scale notes joined by glissandos: one voice gliding without re-attacking.
Il ritmo è quello della mano: il tratto: The rhythm is your hand's: the stroke lasts as long as it took you to draw it.
Disegna con la Pencil · con le dita scor: Draw with the Pencil · scroll with your fingers
Lo spessore segue la pressione: è il vol: Thickness follows pressure: it's the volume.
Rumore su altezza e spessore, come Ink R: Noise on pitch and thickness, like Blender's Ink Rough: irregular vibrato and tremolo.
Grana di grafite, tratto sottile: suono: Graphite grain, thin stroke: darker sound.
Spessore costante, punta piatta: volume: Constant thickness, flat tip: steady volume.
Bordi sfumati: la nota entra piano (atta: Soft edges: the note fades in (slow attack).
Un punto a ogni passo della griglia: il: One dot per grid step: the gesture becomes an arpeggio.
Chiude la forma: suona tutte le note che: Closes the shape: plays every note it covers, as a cluster.

Tap a stroke and all of it disappears.

Picture in picture isn't available here.
Il tratto è la musica: da sinistra a des: The stroke is the music: left to right is time, high notes are at the top, thickness is volume, opacity is brightness.
Disegna le note. Toccalo di nuovo per sc: Draw notes. Tap it again to choose a brush: each one also changes the sound.
Toccala di nuovo per i modi: tratto inte: Tap it again for modes: whole stroke, points, to intersections.
Fai un giro sopra i tratti, poi trascina: Draw a loop around strokes, then drag them: they snap to beats and semitones. Duplicate, change instrument or delete.
Appoggia la Pencil: il tempo scorre da s: Rest the Pencil on the canvas: time moves on its own, you only move up and down. Press harder to play louder.
Ogni livello ha la sua lettura (quantizz: Each layer has its own reading (quantized, optical, legato, gesture), volume and reverb. Hold it for the menu.
Il pallino in alto a destra sceglie lo s: The dot at the top right picks the instrument. Hold it on one of your sounds to edit or delete it.
Due dita: annulla. Tre: ripeti. Quattro:: Two fingers: undo. Three: redo. Four: play/stop. Pinch to zoom. Hold a stroke: eyedropper.
Spessore (volume) e opacità (brillantezz: Brush thickness (volume) and opacity (brightness), undo and redo.
Tocca i numeri di battuta per scegliere: Tap the bar numbers to choose where playback starts. Metronome and BPM are at the bottom.
Il beat suona sotto il disegno, in loop,: The beat plays under the drawing, looping, for the whole length of the canvas.
In Griglia tocchi i passi (un tocco = co: In Grid you tap steps (one tap = hit, two = accent) and drag to paint lots of them. In Pad you play the drums live.
Tocca: solo questa traccia. Tieni premut: Tap: this track only. Hold: hear only this one (again: all). Drag across the M's: all match the first.
Il menu ≡ in alto a destra carica Base,: The ≡ menu at the top right loads Basic, Hip-hop, House, Bossa, Trap or Empty.
Due varianti per traccia; la Sequenza sc: Two variations per track; the Sequence picks which one plays in each bar (A, B or rest).
Tocca: senti il suono. Tieni premuto: vo: Tap: hear the sound. Hold: volume and tuning.
Qui vedi le note che il disegno produce,: Here you see the notes the drawing produces, and you can play and record with the keyboard.
Fai un giro sulle note e trascinale: si: Draw a loop around notes and drag them: the strokes they come from move too.
Suona la tastiera sul vetro (o una tasti: Play the on-screen keyboard (or a MIDI keyboard): the notes become strokes on the active layer.
Se non senti più niente, ricrea l'audio: If you can't hear anything, this rebuilds the audio and rereads the whole drawing.
Gli stessi del Disegna: scegli dove regi: The same as in Draw: choose where to record and with which sound.
Apri un file .mid (anche da GarageBand):: Open a .mid file (from GarageBand too): each track becomes a layer.
Come la colonna sonora ottica di Norman: Like Norman McLaren's optical soundtrack: sound you draw.
Da sinistra a destra disegni una sola vi: From left to right you draw a single vibration: the sound repeats it hundreds of times per second. You choose the note later in Draw.
Il bordo alto è l'orecchio sinistro, que: The top edge is the left ear, the bottom edge the right; the fill between them is the sound. A missing edge mirrors the other one.
Con Tratto le linee sono i bordi; con Pi: With Stroke, the lines are the edges; with Fill, each line becomes a shape. You can switch back and forth: the drawing stays.
Curve morbide suonano dolci, angoli e sc: Soft curves sound sweet, corners and steps sound bright. A flat line makes no sound.
Due dita annullano, tre ripetono. Con la: Two fingers undo, three redo. With the Pencil, fingers don't draw.
Dentro claude.ai alcuni formati non si p: Inside claude.ai some formats can't be saved; in the installed app they can.
Un .zip con il mix WAV, il MIDI con una: A .zip with the WAV mix, MIDI with one track per layer, and the project. Separate tracks for GarageBand too.
Dal menu ⋯ in alto a sinistra puoi impor: From the ⋯ menu at the top left you can import a video, which stays in a floating window above the canvas.
Salva composizione e Apri composizione s: Save composition and Open composition are also in the ⋯ menu.
